description: Source code for the ClaudeCodeHandler class, which manages interactions with the Claude Code API, including message streaming, token counting, and prompt completion.

classes.name: ClaudeCodeHandler
classes.description: Handles communication with the Claude Code API, including message creation, token counting, and prompt completion, with OAuth authentication and reasoning level management.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolChoice
methods.description: Converts OpenAI tool_choice parameter to Anthropic format, handling different input types and parallel call options.

methods.name: getThoughtSignature
methods.description: Returns the last stored thinking signature for interleaved thinking with tool use.

methods.name: getReasoningEffort
methods.description: Determines the reasoning effort level (low/medium/high) based on options and model info.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming message to the Claude Code API, managing OAuth tokens, reasoning levels, tools, and handling streaming chunks.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model ID and info, defaulting if not specified.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in message content using a worker-based tokenizer.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the Claude Code API, returning the generated text.
